title: Bead-free Long Fragment LSK109 Library Preparation
author: John Tyson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7eshjee
materials: Quantify 1 µL of the DNA sample using the Qubit DNA HS kit to confirm DNA recovery and then set up the following End-Prep reaction: 50 µL DNA sample 7 µL Ultra II End-Prep Buffer (NEB) 3 µL Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme mix (NEB)

steps.title: Prepare DNA sample
steps.instruction: Place 10 µg high‑molecular‑weight genomic DNA in 51 µL EB buffer; shear if required.

steps.title: Thermal incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 20 °C for 30 min, then at 65 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Add PEG/NaCl precipitation buffer
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL PEG/NaCl buffer (9 % PEG8000 w/v, 1 M NaCl, 10 M Tris‑Cl pH 8.0) and mix by flicking.

steps.title: Ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 200 µL 70 % ethanol to the tube wall, centrifuge 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant; repeat once. Avoid disturbing the invisible DNA pellet.

steps.title: Air‑dry and resuspend
steps.instruction: Air‑dry DNA for a few minutes, then place tube in the refrigerator (4 °C) to resuspend overnight (shorten if fragments are small).

steps.title: Quantify and set up ligation
steps.instruction: Flick mix, take 1 µL for Qubit HS assay to confirm recovery. Prepare ligation: 33.5 µL DNA, 12.5 µL LNB buffer, 2 µL AMX adapter, 2 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (NEB).

steps.title: Add NaCl and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 4.4 µL 5 M NaCl, then centrifuge at 13 500 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: PEG/NaCl washes
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, wash pellet twice with 200 µL 2‑fold diluted PEG/NaCl buffer (same composition as added earlier), centrifuge 5 min between washes, avoiding pellet disturbance.

steps.title: Add EB buffer and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 26 µL EB buffer (10 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8.0) and place tube in the refrigerator overnight (or shorter if fragments are small).

steps.title: Final quantification
steps.instruction: Flick mix, take 1 µL for Qubit HS assay to confirm DNA recovery.

steps.title: Optional size selection
steps.instruction: If desired, perform a round of size selection using Circulomics PEG‑NaCl buffer as illustrated.

steps.title: Combine with SQB for loading
steps.instruction: Mix library with SQB to achieve 400 ng–1.3 µg total DNA (adjust according to fragment size and recovery) for flowcell loading.

steps.title: Incubate before loading
steps.instruction: Incubate mixture at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge prior to loading
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add final EB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 41 µL EB buffer (10 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8.0) and flick mix.

steps.title: Final precipitation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 30 min to precipitate DNA.
